description:
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing Memnite to deal 1 damage to any target.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter.
Ornithopter enters, triggering Blasting Station untapping it.
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing Ornithopter to deal 1 damage to any target.
Colfenor triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite.
Memnite enters, triggering Blasting Station untapping it.
Repeat.
